verdict.rationale: The evidence documents installation through the plugin marketplace and an option to copy skill folders into a repo's `.claude/skills/`. Neither describes pinned versions, a lockfile, or any control over when updates arrive. Copying folders into a repo is a user-side vendoring workaround, not a documented versioning capability of the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
